concept.hr: Računalo maskom bira odredište ili pristupnik i ARP-om traži njegovu MAC adresu
concept.en: The host ANDs the mask, picks the target or the gateway, resolves its MAC

summary.hr: Ping korak po korak: bitovno I adrese i maske, lokalno ili preko zadanog pristupnika, ARP zahtjev svima, odgovor samo onome koji pita.
summary.en: A ping step by step: address AND mask, local or via the default gateway, an ARP request to all, the reply to the asker only.
